title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: It seemed as if the man would never leave my side now; he would place himself by my side and walk along without ever saying a word, as though he knew all my thoughts as well as myself, and there was always a strange, inexplicable sort of wondering look on the man’s face.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: How many a mental farewell did I take of the black, squared beams in our barracks!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Ah, me!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: How much joyless youth, how much strength for which use there was none, was buried, lost in those walls!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: --youth and strength of which the world might surely have made some use.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: For I must speak my thoughts as to this: the hapless fellows there were perhaps the strongest, and, in one way or another, the most gifted of our people.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: There was all that strength of body and of mind lost, hopelessly lost.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Whose fault is that?

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Yes; whose fault is that?

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: The next day, at an early hour, before the men were mustered for work, I went through all the barracks to bid the men a last farewell.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Many a vigorous, horny hand was held out to me with right good-will.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Some grasped and shook my hand as though all their hearts went with the act; but these were the more generous souls.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Most of the poor fellows seemed so much to feel that, for them, I was already a man changed by what was coming, that they could feel scarce anything else.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: They knew that I had friends in the town, that I was going away at once to gentlemen, that I should sit at their table as their equal.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: This the poor fellows felt; and, although they did their best as they took my hand, that hand could not be the hand of an equal.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: No; I, too, was a gentleman now.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Some turned their backs on me, and made no reply to my parting words.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: I think, too, that I saw looks of aversion on some faces.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: The drum beat; all the convicts went to their work; and I was left to myself.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Souchiloff had got up before everybody that morning, and now set himself tremblingly to the task of getting ready for me a last cup of tea.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Poor Souchiloff!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: How he cried when I gave him my clothes, my shirts, my trouser-straps, and some money.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: “’Tain’t that, ’tain’t that,” he said, and he bit his trembling lips, “it’s that I am going to lose you, Alexander Petrovitch! What shall I do without you?”

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: There was Akim Akimitch, too; him, also, I bade farewell.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: “Your turn to go will come soon, I pray,” said I.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: “Ah, no! I shall remain here long, long, very long yet,” he just managed to say, as he pressed my hand.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: I threw myself on his neck; we kissed.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Ten minutes after the convicts had gone out, my companion and myself left the jail for ever.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: We went to the blacksmith’s shop, where our irons were struck off.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: We had no armed escort, we went there attended by a single sub-officer.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: It was convicts who struck off our irons in the engineers’ workshop.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: I let them do it for my friend first, then went to the anvil myself.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: The smiths made me turn round, seized my leg, and stretched it on the anvil.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Then they went about the business methodically, as though they wanted to make a very neat job of it indeed.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: “The rivet, man, turn the rivet first,” I heard the master smith say; “there, so, so. Now, a stroke of the hammer!”

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: The irons fell.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: I lifted them up.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Some strange impulse made me long to have them in my hands for one last time.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: I couldn’t realise that, only a moment before, they had been on my limbs.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: “Good-bye! Good-bye! Good-bye!” said the convicts in their broken voices; but they seemed pleased as they said it.

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Yes, farewell!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Liberty!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: New life!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Resurrection from the dead!

title: The house of the dead :  or, Prison life in Siberia
text: Unspeakable moment!
